title: Billing Expedited Refund and Settlement Limits
provenance: Authored for the RefundFlow offline simulation; this text is not copied from external services.
license_notes: Synthetic demo text; not legal advice.
excerpts: Expedited refund review applies to orders above a high-value threshold and requires a documented approval record.
Never accelerate settlement without the originating payment reference and an approved exception review.
Record the expedited approval decision, approver, and authorized settlement window for audit.
An expedited refund recommendation changes only the settlement timeline, not the underlying eligibility rules.
